title: Al-Muḥyī al-Mumīt — The One Responsible For Both Life and Death

blocks.text: This name also is derived from (the original act of) bringing into being. But when the existent is life, bringing into being is called *ḥiāyʾ,* and when it is death, its bringing into being is called **imāta.** No one creates death and life except God Most High. There is no **muḥyī** or **mumīt** except God Most High. An indication of the meaning of life was presented before in the name *al-Bāʿith,* and we do not return to it here.
